observations: The reviewed bind-pose hero view reads as a large eagle: dark body, copper breast, sun-gold crown, ivory hooked beak, talons, paired extended wings, and a broad tail are all visible.

The reviewed side view keeps the head, beak, eye, folded wing volumes, legs, talons, and separate tail plumes visibly connected; no detached source part or inverted open flight sheet was seen in the static source pose.
The expanded-wing presentation intentionally exaggerates the Roc silhouette. The off-center studio camera favors the head and near wing, so live gameplay remains the test of combat readability.
limits: This is a static offline source review under studio lighting, not an FTK camera, material, animation, portrait, culling, or lifecycle result.
The wing panels and primary feathers need exact attack/death motion review before they can be called animation-safe.
decision: The source has enough readable, original structure to justify a fresh isolated native binding trial; it is not accepted finished art.
